description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Replace Windows authentication with Microsoft Entra ID and align admin access rules. Addresses issues: Windows authentication detected.
tasks.reason: Azure app hosting options do not support the current Windows-auth dependency, so identity must be modernized before the app can be cut over.
tasks.requirements: Move the app off Windows authentication so it can run on Azure hosting without relying on workstation or domain sign-in. Preserve the current admin and user experience, keep the MVC authorization flow coherent, and map existing roles or claims so admin-only features still work.
tasks.taskSummary: Implemented OWIN-based OpenID Connect authentication against Microsoft Entra ID, replacing IIS Windows Authentication. Added role-based authorization via EntraAuthorizeAttribute, sign-in/sign-out flow, and UI updates. All admin-only actions now properly secured. Build succeeds.

tasks.description: Externalize application settings and secrets into Azure App Configuration and Azure Key Vault. Addresses issues: Connection strings without configuration builders detected.
tasks.reason: The app currently keeps cloud-facing settings in Web.config and needs a secure, centrally managed configuration source for Azure.
tasks.requirements: Move non-secret application settings out of Web.config into Azure App Configuration and move secrets or sensitive connection material into Azure Key Vault. Use managed identity for runtime access and keep the current configuration consumers working with minimal shape changes.
tasks.taskSummary: Wired Web.config appSettings/connectionStrings to Azure App Configuration and Azure Key Vault via .NET Framework Configuration Builders (AzureAppConfigurationBuilder / AzureKeyVaultConfigBuilder), authenticated with Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential), with optional=true local fallback. Zero changes required to configuration consumers (ConfigurationManager.AppSettings/ConnectionStrings usages unchanged). Added Azure SDK packages/references and binding redirects. Build succeeds; consistency check passed with zero issues. Pre-existing (baseline) test project reference gap noted separately.

tasks.description: Move the EF Core data layer from LocalDB to Azure SQL Database. Addresses issues: SQL database connection detected.
tasks.reason: The current database is tied to LocalDB and must be replaced with an Azure-managed database service for cloud hosting.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the EF Core persistence layer to Azure SQL Database while preserving the current schema, seed data, and CRUD behavior. Replace any local integrated-security assumptions with Azure-safe access and keep the application data model consistent during cutover.
tasks.taskSummary: Migrated LocalDB connection settings to Azure SQL Database using Managed Identity authentication (Authentication=Active Directory Default), upgraded Microsoft.Data.SqlClient, and aligned dependency/binding redirect versions. Build succeeds and no LocalDB/System.Data.SqlClient references remain in configuration or code paths for runtime DB access.

tasks.description: Move teaching-material uploads from local disk to Azure Blob Storage. Addresses issues: Local or network IO operations detected; Static content detected; path traversal risk around uploaded files.
tasks.reason: The current upload flow relies on local file paths and cannot be depended on in cloud hosting.
tasks.requirements: Move course teaching-material uploads and deletions off local disk into Azure Blob Storage. Keep upload validation, preserve the stored reference used by the UI and database, and remove filesystem path assumptions from persisted upload handling.
tasks.taskSummary: Migrated CoursesController upload/delete flows off local disk (~/Uploads/TeachingMaterials/) onto Azure Blob Storage via a new IBlobStorageService/AzureBlobStorageService (Azure.Storage.Blobs, DefaultAzureCredential, private container created idempotently). Stored TeachingMaterialImagePath now holds the absolute blob URL (Views already render it via @Url.Content, unchanged). Removed the unused local-disk FileStorage/IFileStorage abstraction and the Uploads directory. Added AzureStorage:AccountName/ContainerName app settings (Azure App Configuration-backed). Used Azure.Storage.Blobs 12.24.0/Azure.Storage.Common 12.23.0 (Azure.Core bumped to 1.44.1) instead of the newest SDK line to avoid a large, high-risk dependency cascade across the already-completed 001-003 tasks. Build succeeds; consistency check passed with zero issues. Pre-existing (baseline) test project reference gap (same one noted in task 002/003) remains outside this task's/repo's scope.

tasks.description: Replace MSMQ-based notifications with Azure Service Bus. Addresses issues: MSMQ usage is detected; improper synchronization and permission assignment around the queue.
tasks.reason: MSMQ is not a fit for the Azure hosting target and the queue implementation currently has security and concurrency problems.
tasks.requirements: Replace MSMQ-backed notification handling with Azure Service Bus while preserving the admin notification workflow and queue-based buffering. Remove direct MessageQueue dependencies, eliminate broad queue permissions, and keep notification delivery resilient under Azure hosting.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities before Azure cutover.
tasks.reason: The application should not move into Azure with known vulnerable dependencies or unresolved security advisories.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities to the minimum patched version. If a fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the upgraded major version, and the breaking-change risk. Keep the project building and all tests passing after remediation.
